meta.summary: NTS Radio: hides sign-up pop-ups and the Shop row, blurs or hides artwork, can hide genre tags, mixtape slider and News row
meta.notes:
**Checked 2026-11-13**, logged out, headless Chrome on https://www.nts.live/ with an iPhone UA and a desktop UA. Both received the same React page with readable class names.

- **Sign-up pop-up**: `.modal-onboarding--auth` 1 and `.full-page-overlay--auth` 1 are rendered in the page but sit closed; they open on actions such as saving a favourite (LIVE for existence, INFERRED for how they appear). `.modal-promo` is shared with the Live Tracklists card, so the rule does not target it.
- **Shop row**: `section#shop-collection` 1; **News and Events** `section.home-incoming` 1 (their tiles were still skeletons in the capture) (LIVE).
- **Artwork**: `.nts-grid-picture` 25 desktop, 25 phone (LIVE).
- **Genre tags**: `a.nts-tag` 36 on desktop (0 on the phone home, where tags are not shown) (LIVE).
- **Mixtape slider**: `section.mixtape-slider` 1 (LIVE).

Not verified: show and episode pages (the capture of one failed when the network dropped), the Explore pages, the live player drawer (never hidden), a login. The player bars (`.footer-player`) and live header are never targeted.
